_meta.description: Every BOTW material that can go into a cooking pot (key items, dyes and pictures excluded).

units.hearts: cureItemHitPointRecover: raw heal in QUARTER hearts as stored in the game (4 = one heart). Cooking doubles it.
units.potency: cureItemEffectLevel: effect points this ingredient adds toward its effect.
units.timeBoost: cookSpiceBoostEffectiveTime in seconds. Monster parts (CookEnemy): added per copy to any timed effect. CookSpice items: added once per distinct item.
units.hpBoost: cookSpiceBoostHitPointRecover in quarter hearts, added once per distinct CookSpice item (not doubled).
units.critBoost: cookSpiceBoostSuccessRate: critical-cook chance bonus in percent.
units.sellPrice: itemSellingPrice (rupees the shop pays you). buyPrice: itemBuyingPrice.
units.tags: Game cooking tags used by the recipe table (CookFruit, CookEnemy, ...).

sources: Pistonite/botw-recipe research/output/actor-data.yaml (game parameter dump; MIT License)
savage13/cooking.rs src/cook_items.json for Monster Extract only (BSD-2-Clause)
